text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At the autumn Tenno Sho, the Eternal Top Three—Oguri Cap, Super Creek, and Inari One—are preparing to fight for the crown. But they're not the only ones.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O is ready as well. She acknowledges her waning self, and vows not to break down—instead, she's going to break free.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She heads into the paddock determined to shatter her old self, and find a new version of herself among the debris.
